messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem 1 action triage. Need final owners + ETAs for backups verification, restore runbook, routing policy, and game day.

mira: Can we include exact Route53 commands in the runbook? Last swap was ambiguous. :eyes: 

jordan: Ill own backups verification. Plan: full snap restore from eu/us into staging and run smoke checks. Target Tue EOD. :white_check_mark: 

casey: Ill take runbook edits  clarify step order, add explicit rollback examples, and include verification snippets. ETA Fri COB.

raj: Ill own routing policy + canary test. Suggested canary: 5% weight to eu for 30m, monitor error-rate. Script Ill use:

```
# canary shift to eu
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.test.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"canary-eu","Weight":5,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"3.4.5.6"}]}}]}'
```

raj: Auto-rollback if error-rate > 0.5% during canary. Ops: need an alert hook for the metric.

mira: For the restore snippet please include mount + minimal SQL smoke, e.g. `SELECT count(1) FROM customers LIMIT 1;` so on-call can validate quickly.

alex: Jordan + Casey pair on the exact verification commands. Jordan: attach CLI restore + smoke SQL; Casey: copy into runbook.

sylvia: I'll centralize items in the incident tracker and create recurring reminders. Tracker: https://redwood-internal/incident-tracker/DR-rotation-2026. Columns: owner, status, ETA, blockers, last-tested.

jordan: Restore checklist for runbook: 1) restore snapshot to staging (`aws rds restore-db-instance-from-db-snapshot --db-snapshot-identifier <snap>`), 2) adjust SGs, 3) run smoke SQL above, 4) run routing smoke via canary proxy.

ops-bot: Reminder: DR game day Fri 09:00 UTC. Please RSVP.

casey: Runbook draft updated with rollback examples: https://redwood-internal/docs/dr-restore-runbook-draft. PTAL.

raj: Ill also add expected client timeout/retry knobs to the routing playbook (short table).

alex: Action summary: backups verification -> jordan (Tue EOD); runbook edits -> casey + jordan (Fri COB); routing canary -> raj (coordinate with ops); tracker/reminders -> sylvia (today).

mira: I can be backup for raj on game day. Put me down as secondary.

sylvia: Tracker updated and weekly reminders created. Invited owners.

alex: Thanks all. Well reconvene after game day for a short follow-up writeup and any remaining action items.

ops-bot: Game day reminder will post 1h before start.
